assessment: In this study, Olive and colleagues used a genetic screen to identify new regulators underpinning the ability of the cytokine IFNγ to upregulate MHC class II molecules, of relevance to our understanding of how macrophages are activated by IFNγ to confer host defense during microbial infection. They identified the signaling protein GSK3β, and MED16, a subunit of the Mediator complex previously implicated in gene induction.
